result:
Round 141 (V-0.4d) **passes** at both 1440×900 and 1280×720. Every check that can run here was run in a real browser, so `browserVerified` = `realVerified` = true. There are no Critical, High or Medium bugs, and one new Low.

**What I checked:**
- **Track names:** on a fresh load the headers read Video, Music, Stems and SFX, both on screen and in the aria-labels. Adding a library sound to Music gives `“ღამის პულსი · პადი” added to the Music track at 00:02.000.` (the sound's title is demo data and stays Georgian until V-0.5). The Music meter title reads `Music · Peak −15.8 dBFS`.
- **Group names:**
  - Grouping Music and Stems gives `Group “Group 1” created: Music, Stems.`
  - Grouping Group 1 with SFX gives `Group “Group 2” created: Group 1, SFX.` Ungrouping it gives `Group “Group 2” ungrouped.`
  - After renaming Group 1 to Drums, a new group is again named `Group 1`, so a renamed group frees its number.
  - Every Undo and Redo title along the way is in English.
- **Group mute, real audio:** muting the group drops the output by about 179 dB at both sizes. Unmuting restores it to within 0.03 dB.
- **Georgian count:** zero left outside the parts the task leaves for later (library, detail panel, video dock, page title). I also discounted the demo badge `დემო კოლექცია — ავტორიზაცია არ სჭირდება`, which is not on the task's explicit list. I counted it under the later-round "collection messages"; B should confirm.
- **Layout:** no button or fader box moved more than 1 px, and the group row matches the round-140 sizes exactly.
- **Premium access:** a fresh browser with no login opens `/studio-lab` normally. `/studio/middle-east` shows "Sign in required" with no workspace and no audio loaded. The studio token request returns 401. Separately, I re-ran A's 23 test files: 293/293 pass, the same as A.
- **Source:** only the 17 granted files changed, the protected files are untouched, and the source tree was identical at the start and end of my phase.

**Blocked:** the check that a fake login token gets 403 needs the backend, which isn't available in the cloud. It is listed as blocked, not passed.

**New Low, C-R141-01:** a group named Drums nested inside Group 1 shows as `Dru…` at 1280. I think the existing header layout causes it rather than this round, but I didn't measure a nested group in round 140, so that's an inference. It goes to the deferred Low polish list.

**Ableton:** Live's default group and track names are not in B's manual capture, so that comparison is marked unconfirmed. I make no claim that Live behaves the same way.

My first harness runs had three bugs in my own scripts, not the app; they are listed as invalid runs and replaced by clean re-runs. The full test suite, build, verify and e2e belong to the root gate and are not claimed here.

Files are in `tmp/studio-real-loop`:
- c-round-141.md
- c-round-141.json
- c-round-141/ (tools, out, shots)
